- Completed improve-code-boundaries smell 10 in src/command/mod.rs by proving authority_primary_member_label had a single caller, then inlining authoritative_primary_member(state).map(MemberId::as_str) into state_row and deleting the helper.
- Verification completed successfully: make check, make lint, and make test all passed; make test reported 233 passed / 16 skipped / 5 leaky, and the leak set already has an existing bug file at .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-api-worker-reload-certificate-tests-leak.md.
- Committed and pushed 47eba65 and 80c056b to origin/master, then ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it succeeded, refreshed current task summaries, sent the summary email, and repeated the non-fatal missing .ralph/current_task.txt cleanup warning.

- Read prior Ralph progress: last run completed a smell-10 cleanup in src/command/mod.rs, passed make check/lint/test, committed/pushed, and switched task.
- Read .agents/skills/improve-code-boundaries/SKILL.md. found_smells/ only contains .gitkeep, so I need to choose a new smell. Current worktree is already dirty in src/ha/decide.rs plus .ralph task files/progress.
- Next: inspect smell guidance and search src/tests for one concrete boundary issue that reduces code without colliding with existing edits, then implement and verify with make lint and make test.

- Proved smell-10 candidate in src/cli/connect.rs with the required rename workflow. Renamed resolve_primary_view to wrong_helper_test_resolve_primary_view and ran make check.
- Compiler showed a single real caller at src/cli/connect.rs:23 in run_primary; no other call sites failed, so resolve_primary_view is a guilty single-caller helper.
- Next: revert the rename by inlining resolve_primary_view into run_primary, then rerun make check/lint/test and finish the Ralph loop.

- Inlined src/cli/connect.rs::resolve_primary_view into run_primary and deleted the helper. The command workflow now owns the authoritative-primary lookup, endpoint validation, DTO construction, and render call in one place.
- make check passed after the refactor, so the single-caller helper removal is compile-clean.
- Next: run make lint and make test, then commit all tracked changes including .ralph, push, and switch task.

- make lint passed cleanly.
- make test failed before executing tests: nextest/cargo hit a linker failure for test `ha` with missing generated `ha-...rcgu.o` object files. This matches existing bug .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-nextest-incremental-linking-can-miss-ha-test-object-files.md, so no duplicate bug file is needed.
- Next: retry make test once to see whether the known incremental-linking artifact issue reproduces or clears, then decide whether this run can complete commit/push or must stop on verification failure.

- Retried make test once. It failed the same way again during nextest build for test `ha`, with /usr/bin/ld reporting missing generated `ha-...rcgu.o` files.
- This is a stable repro of the already-tracked bug .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-nextest-incremental-linking-can-miss-ha-test-object-files.md, not a duplicate new bug.
- Next: inspect git state, commit only my refactor plus intended .ralph updates (not unrelated src/ha/decide.rs changes), push, run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh, and report that make test is currently blocked by the known nextest incremental-linking bug.
